title: Reading the site name, template settings or language overrides takes no write lease, waits for no seal and writes no Site changes row; a failed lease release is tried again while the lease is still that turn's
steps: S1: Ask tracy-web's changesSite whether site.identity, template.siteSettings and template.languageOverrides change the site with operation set, read, and none.
S2: Ask tracy-site-tabs callMayWriteSite / callChangedSite and tracy-site-tools tierOf the same, plus site.identity with new fields and no operation.
S3: End a turn that wrote while the lease release door answers 503, then a network error, then 200; and one whose door answers 403.
S4: End a turn that wrote while the release door answers 503, and let the same conversation write again before the second try.
expect: S2: a write only for set, or for new values with no operation; tierOf mutating for those, readonly otherwise.
S3: three tries with pauses of 1 s and 3 s, then stop; the 403 is tried once.
evidence: route.js said the two template doors were 'still counted as writes here: a separate fix, reported, not made'; Apply reads the language overrides page by page through the Apply door, each read a Tracy setup row and a renewed lease
fence: One set-only rule read by the apply door, the agent's tiers and the seal wait; the lease release door frees by session, so retries stop once the next turn holds the lease

tests: the template settings and language override doors write on set only
callMayWriteSite and callChangedSite: the set-only doors write on set
the set-only doors are mutating on set
a lease release that meets a restarting Tracy
🔒 a later lease release never frees the lease
